term: founded by God: through an envoy or immediately
resolution: The original root predicate FoundedAsTeachingAuthority and all existing Challenges stay unchanged. The envoy bridge remains a Jesus-specific one-way implication, not a definition equating that predicate with an agency event. The new direct-only and envoy-inclusive calibrations are explicit open propositions on IsGod candidates. Direct-only says the target coextends with the supplied principal-own-act relation; inclusive says it coextends with direct founding or FoundedInMandate jesus g c plus CommissionedToTeach jesus c. Neither adds HoldsMandate or Jesus≠g. These two minimal readings may overlap. The stronger old immediate-without-creature glossary requires an additional exclusion; the new exclusive reading encodes only its Jesus-event fragment, not every creature. Given an actual commissioned-event witness that extra exclusion contradicts the old envoy bridge; minimal direct calibration alone does not. The case’s existing stage, attestation, veracity and scope premises derive such a witness conditionally. Named coverage of the two minimal calibrations remains an open premise; the logical fork includes a precise additional-reading case, whose models admit opposite old-bridge verdicts. No preferred meaning, source attribution, historical event or root premise is established. The existing Dei Filius per-Filium lead remains compatible with multiple readings; on its theology the Son is God, while Signature does not identify jesus with an IsGod being. The older stage-5 Founded jesus c remains separate, and no societies founded by other envoys are silently added.
